name: Chicken Fricassée with Creamy Mushroom-Spinach Sauce, Parsley & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add chicken to the pot and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Return pot (with drippings) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour over veggies and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, 1-2 minutes.
Stir in broth and cream, then bring the sauce to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook until thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
chicken or vegetable broth
6 fl oz (¾ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside a small handful for serving.
When the sauce has thickened, add remaining parsley and spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, sauce, and chicken between plates. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
